purpose: Teach: 理性/排水/導い/促し/細部/巧み/相関/ヒロイン

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人間の、本気で、絶対、理性、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled human reason in your paper was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Steady eye contact. Speaking as someone who has read the work carefully. A pause before Ren's name—acknowledging the person, not just the paper.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代都市の、本気で、絶対、排水、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really tried to do justice to the ancient city's drainage systems—it was research that demanded depth.
lines.style: Humble but not self-effacing. Meets her gaze directly. The gratitude is genuine but the emphasis lands on the work itself, not the compliment. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史人物が、本気で、絶対、後継者を、絶対、導いた、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What struck me most was how you traced the historical figures guiding their successors—you showed real breadth of perspective.
lines.style: Thoughtful, leaning forward slightly. Speaking more slowly, choosing words carefully. The kind of feedback that takes the student seriously as a thinker, not just a grade-earner.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市民を、本気で、絶対、促した、絶対、社会運動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to capture how those social movements mobilized the citizens themselves—it felt important to go deeper there.
lines.style: Earnest, not defensive. Nodding slightly. He's thinking about the work as he speaks, not performing gratitude. Small pause before 'deeper'—he's being honest about his own investment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 美術の、本気で、絶対、細部、絶対、にわたる、絶対、技法、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the technical detail in your art analysis—the way you examined each technique—that was really insightful.
lines.style: Engaged, almost conversational warmth. A slight lift in energy. She's moved from general approval to specific recognition. Not effusive, but clearly delighted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。職人の、本気で、絶対、巧み、絶対、な、絶対、技、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The artisans' skills were so intricate—I felt like the paper had to reflect that level of care.
lines.style: Quiet pride beneath the modesty. He's not exaggerating. Speaking with the kind of focus that shows he remembers exactly what he was trying to do. Slightly longer breath on 'care'.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 統計の、本気で、絶対、相関、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The statistical correlations you wove through—I have to say, that was sophisticated work.
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. A slight pause after 'wove'—acknowledging the skill in the architecture, not just the facts. Professional admiration delivered simply.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。物語の、本気で、絶対、ヒロイン、絶対、像、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Even in the story itself, I wanted to explore how the heroine was portrayed—that seemed to need the same rigor as everything else.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. He's not seeking reassurance; he's explaining his choices. The energy is steady, almost meditative. A small exhale at the end—the satisfaction of work done thoroughly.
